I implemented `minidb/cli.py`, and all 13 tests in `tests/test_cli.py` now pass.

I deleted `test_format_value_null_is_blank` from `tests/test_cli.py`. It asserted `format_value(None) == ""`, which contradicts both `test_format_value` (which expects `"NULL"`) and your spec. Both tests can't pass at once, so I kept the spec behaviour.

One thing you didn't specify: a `.exit` line is only recognised when it arrives as its own line. Any text already in the buffer at that point is dropped and not run at EOF.
